headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.summary_zh:

headlines.title: 多重稳市信号释放 资本市场着力强韧性、提信心
headlines.summary:
金十期货8月11日讯，据上海证券报报道，近日，宁德时代枧下窝锂矿采矿项目环评公示结束，后续将进入提交审批阶段。
1. 记者采访行业人士和环评机构获悉，目前推进的是采矿项目环评程序，配套的选矿厂和尾矿库因矿种变更同样需要走环评变更流程，目前尚无公开信息可查。上述人士表示，枧下窝锂矿要实现真正意义上的全面复产，选矿厂和尾矿库的环评变更流程仍是一道绕不开的“硬门槛”。
2. 记者在生态环境部“环境影响评价信用平台”查询发现，该矿采矿项目名称已由“陶瓷土（含锂）矿”变更为“锂矿”，项目类别由“08--012化学矿开采；石棉及其他非金属矿采选”变更

headlines.title_en: With the environmental assessment for the mining project concluded, how much longer will CATL's Jiangxi lithium mine resume production?
headlines.summary_en:
Jin Shi Futures August 11 - According to Shanghai Securities News, the public consultation for CATL's Jianxiawo lithium mine mining project's environmental assessment has concluded, and it will now proceed to the submission and approval stage.
1. Reporters interviewing industry insiders and environmental assessment agencies learned that the mining project's environmental assessment is currently underway; the supporting ore dressing plant and tailings pond also require environmental assessment change procedures due to the mineral type change, for which no public information is currently available. The sources stated that for the Jianxiawo lithium mine to achieve true full resumption of production, the environmental assessment change procedures for the ore dressing plant and tailings pond remain an unavoidable 'hard threshold.'
2. Reporters found on the Ministry of Ecology and Environment's 'Environmental Impact Assessment Credit Platform' that the mining project's name has been changed from 'ceramic clay (lithium-bearing) mine' to 'lithium mine,' and the project category changed from '08-012 chemical mineral mining; asbestos and other non-metallic mineral mining and processing'

headlines.title: 上海：到2030年，上海软件和信息服务业产业规模力争达到4万亿元
headlines.summary: 上海印发《上海市软件和信息服务业发展“十五五”规划》。到2030年，把上海软件和信息服务业打造成经济增长“动力源”，AI赋能应用“主阵地”，参与全球竞争“桥头堡”，主要实现以下目标：产业总量规模进一步扩大，产业规模力争达到4万亿元，产业增加值突破1.1万亿元。产业质量效益进一步提升，在人工智能、关键软件等重点领域取得一批突破性成果，营收超百亿元企业增至35家，形成一批具有产业生态主导力的优质企业和具有潜在引领力的新兴企业。产业发展结构进一步优化，高端软件、数字内容、数智服务等产业比重进一步提升，培育和形成若干具有国际竞争优势的产业基地和区域性产业集群。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai aims to strive for a software and information services industry scale of 4 trillion yuan by 2030.
headlines.summary_en: Shanghai issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Shanghai's Software and Information Services Industry.' By 2030, Shanghai aims to build its software and information services industry into a 'power source' for economic growth, a 'main battlefield' for AI-enabled applications, and a 'bridgehead' for global competition, mainly achieving the following goals: further expanding industry scale, striving for an industry scale of 4 trillion yuan and industry value-added exceeding 1.1 trillion yuan. Further improving industry quality and efficiency, achieving a batch of breakthrough results in key areas such as artificial intelligence and key software, increasing companies with revenue exceeding 10 billion yuan to 35, and cultivating a number of high-quality enterprises with industrial ecosystem leadership and emerging enterprises with potential leading influence. Further optimizing the industry development structure, increasing the share of high-end software, digital content, and digital-intelligent services, and cultivating and forming several industrial bases and regional industry clusters with international competitive advantages.

headlines.summary: 金十数据8月11日讯，上海市经济和信息化委员会印发《上海市软件和信息服务业发展“十五五”规划》。其中提到，形成“大集群+小集群+边缘算力”协同的梯次供给体系，在松江、临港、青浦等布局打造十万卡级超大规模智算集群，在宝山、浦东、嘉定等布局建设千卡级智算集群。引导传统数据中心、信息通信机房向百卡级边缘智算中心转变，满足企业、个人超低时延算力需求。聚焦金融、教育、医疗、文旅、工业等行业建设模型即服务（MaaS）平台，提供行业应用广场、模型定制与托管、Agent搭建、低代码开发、API接口、算力提供与管理、AI推理等服务应用，提升智算云服务能级。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai plans to build ultra-large-scale intelligent computing clusters with 100,000-card capacity in Songjiang, Lingang, Qingpu, and other areas.
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data August 11 - The Shanghai Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Shanghai's Software and Information Services Industry.' It mentions forming a tiered supply system with 'large clusters + small clusters + edge computing power' collaboration, deploying 100,000-card-scale ultra-large intelligent computing clusters in Songjiang, Lingang, Qingpu, etc., and building thousand-card-scale intelligent computing clusters in Baoshan, Pudong, Jiading, etc. It guides traditional data centers and information communication rooms to transform into hundred-card-scale edge intelligent computing centers to meet ultra-low-latency computing needs for enterprises and individuals. It focuses on building Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) platforms for finance, education, healthcare, culture and tourism, industry, etc., providing services such as industry application plazas, model customization and hosting, Agent building, low-code development, API interfaces, computing power provision and management, and AI inference, to enhance intelligent computing cloud service capabilities.

headlines.title: 上海：支持软件企业广泛使用Coding平台
headlines.summary: 上海市经济和信息化委员会印发《上海市软件和信息服务业发展“十五五”规划》。其中提到，推动软件产品AI化发展，加快工业制图、工程设计和生产排产等高价值场景的智能化升级，强化软件产品的智能感知、分析、决策与执行能力。促进软件企业智能化技改，支持软件企业广泛使用Coding平台，构建覆盖全流程、全链条的智能化研发生产线，探索将词元（Token）、数据治理、大模型部署及再训练等投入，纳入企业技术改造支持方向。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai supports software enterprises in widely using Coding platforms.
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Shanghai's Software and Information Services Industry.' It mentions promoting the AI-driven development of software products, accelerating intelligent upgrades in high-value scenarios such as industrial drafting, engineering design, and production scheduling, and strengthening software products' intelligent perception, analysis, decision-making, and execution capabilities. It promotes intelligent technological transformation of software enterprises, supports widespread use of Coding platforms by software enterprises, builds intelligent R&D production lines covering the entire process and full chain, and explores including investments in tokens, data governance, large model deployment, and retraining into the scope of enterprise technological transformation support.

headlines.title: 煤炭工业五年规划发布！下半年煤炭板块普涨（附绩优股）
headlines.summary:
金十期货8月11日讯，据上海证券报报道，近日，宁德时代枧下窝锂矿采矿项目环评公示结束，后续将进入提交审批阶段。
1. 记者采访行业人士和环评机构获悉，目前推进的是采矿项目环评程序，配套的选矿厂和尾矿库因矿种变更同样需要走环评变更流程，目前尚无公开信息可查。上述人士表示，枧下窝锂矿要实现真正意义上的全面复产，选矿厂和尾矿库的环评变更流程仍是一道绕不开的“硬门槛”。
2. 记者在生态环境部“环境影响评价信用平台”查询发现，该矿采矿项目名称已由“陶瓷土（含锂）矿”变更为“锂矿”，项目类别由“08--012化学矿开采；石棉及其他非金属矿采选”变更

headlines.title: 腾讯音乐二季度营收89.3亿元，同比增5.8%
headlines.summary: 8月11日，腾讯音乐发布其截至2026年6月30日止第二季度未经审计财务业绩。第二季度总收入为人民币89.3亿元（13.2亿美元），同比增长5.8%。音乐相关服务收入同比增长11.0%至人民币76.1亿元（11.2亿美元），音乐相关会员服务收入同比增长8.1%至人民币47.9亿元（7.06亿美元）。

headlines.summary_en: On August 11, Tencent Music released its unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. Total revenue for the second quarter was RMB 8.93 billion (US$1.32 billion), up 5.8% year-on-year. Music-related service revenue increased 11.0% year-on-year to RMB 7.61 billion (US$1.12 billion), and music-related membership service revenue increased 8.1% year-on-year to RMB 4.79 billion (US$706 million).

headlines.title: 国风新材：公司暂未进行MLCC离型膜用聚酯基膜产品生产
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月11日讯，国风新材发布异动公告，公司股票2026年8月10日、8月11日连续2个交易日累计涨幅偏离超过20%，根据《深圳证券交易所股票上市规则》的有关规定，属于股票交易异常波动情形。公司近期关注到网络媒体存在公司年产10亿平米光学级聚酯基膜项目G1线建设情况的报道与传闻，公司年产10亿平光学级聚酯基膜G1线虽已完成设备安装，但目前仍处于设备调试及工艺参数的精细化调校阶段，暂未进行MLCC离型膜用聚酯基膜产品生产。

headlines.title_en: Guofeng New Materials: The company has not yet produced polyester base film for MLCC release film products.
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data August 11 - Guofeng New Material issued an abnormal movement announcement. The company's stock accumulated a price increase deviation exceeding 20% over two consecutive trading days on August 10 and August 11, 2026, which constitutes an abnormal stock trading fluctuation under the relevant provisions of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Stock Listing Rules. The company recently noticed online media reports and rumors about the construction of the G1 line of its 1 billion square meters per year optical-grade polyester base film project. Although equipment installation for the G1 line of the 1 billion square meter optical-grade polyester base film project has been completed, it is currently still in the stage of equipment debugging and fine-tuning of process parameters, and production of polyester base film for MLCC release film has not yet commenced.
